rules: LLD-01 deliberately registers no concrete Beta business job type in this packet.
Concrete job registries in LLD-04/06/08/09/12 supply payload/checkpoint/retry/crash/cancellation/sensitivity/coalescing contracts consumed by the Foundation coordinator.

Each packet coalescing contract deterministically derives its semantic dedupe key from the exact validated payload and declares the technical states that count as a coalescing match; Foundation hashes/looks up that identity but never invents its meaning.
A future Foundation-owned concrete job requires an explicit versioned entry here before implementation.
